simple.meaning: עָשַׁק (ʻâshaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to press upon , i.e. oppress , defraud , violate , overflow.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 36 times across Leviticus, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Job, and 11 more, beginning at Leviticus 5:21. Its contexts include family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָשַׁק (H6231).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָשַׁק (ʻâshaq) / H6231 is traced through Leviticus 5:21, Leviticus 5:23, Leviticus 19:13, Deuteronomy 24:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6231. ashaq עָשַׁק verb oppress, wrong, extort ( עֲשַׁק ᵑ7 = Biblical Hebrew, so Old Aramaic עשק ; Syriac accuse, slander ; Assyrian adjective eš‡u , strong ; Arabic roughness, injustice ); — Qal Perfect ׳ע Leviticus 5:21; Ezek 18:18 ; 2 masculine singular suffix עֲשַׁקְתָּ֫נוּ 1Sam 12:4 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יַעַשׁקֻנִי Psa 119:122 ; 2 masculine singular תַּעֲשֹׁק Lev 19:13 +, etc.; Infinitive construct עֲשֹׁק Hosea 12:8 , suffix עָשְׁקָם 1Chr 16:21 ; Psa 105:14 ; Participle active עשֵׁק Prov 14:31 +, feminine plural הָעשְׁקוֺת Amos 4:1 , etc.; passive עָשׁוּק Deut 28:29 +, etc.; — 1 oppress, wrong (often by extortion, || גָּזַל ), with accusative of person 1Sam 12:3-4 , Micah 2:2 ; Leviticus 5:21; Lev 19:13 ; especially the poor and helpless Amos 4:1 ; Deut 24:14 ; Jer 7:6 ; Ezek 22:29 ; Zech 7:10 ; Prov 14:31 ; 22:16 ; 28:3 ; Eccl 4:1 ; also with accusative of congnate meaning with verb ׳ע גָּזֵל (וְ)גָזַל עשֶׁק Ezek 18:18 practise extortion , 22:29 , take by extortion Leviticus 5:23 and (with accusative of thing) Mal 3:5 ; absolute Hosea 12:8 practise extortion ; Job 10:3 deal tyrannically (of God); participle oppressor, extortioner Jer 21:12 ; Psa 72:4 ; Eccl 4:1 ; passive participle as substantive the oppressed Psa 103:6 ; 146:7 . 2 oppress a nation Isa 52:4 , compare Psa 105:14 = 1Chr 16:21 ; Psa 119:122 , participle act. oppressor 119:121 , passive participle oppressed Jer 50:33 , in predict. ׳ע וְגָזוּל Deut 28:29 , ׳ע וְרָצּוּץ 28:23 ; Hosea 5:11 . 3 dubious are: נָהָר יַעְשֹׁק Job 40:23 a river oppresses him, i.e. rushes violently upon him (that is, the hippopotamus; Du יָשֹׁק , from שׁוּק ; > Gunk Bu יִשְׁקַע falls, sinks ); נֶפֶשׁ בְּדַם עָשֻׁק Prov 28:17 oppressed (? burdened) with the blood of a person. Pu`al Participle feminine הַמְּעֻשָּׁקָה Isa 23:12 crushed (of conquered Sidon under figure of woman).
